{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm that there are exactly 6 internal test orders
internal_test_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
assert internal_test_count == 6, f'Expected 6 internal test orders, found {internal_test_count}'

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
